ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, May 4, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Informatics Minor students on Monday, May 11, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. The course considers how social media provides a new platform for unprecedented collaboration, new ways of engaging customers, and the benefits and challenges of social media. The course will take a strategic approach by helping students understand the business impact on the firm and building the requisite skills to create value in this new reality.
